Enjoy cutting-edge technology like the 11.3-inch Google Built-In infotainment system, Amazon Alexa compatibility, and over-the-air map updates for seamless connectivity. Advanced safety features include Intersection Pre-collision and Turn Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keeping Assist with Blind Spot Integration, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Pedestrian Detection. Stay comfortable with automatic climate control and enjoy the convenience of remote engine start and customizable digital displays. If you're looking for an efficient, tech-forward EV with standout safety and comfort, this Bolt LT is ready for your next adventure. Advertised price includes all mandatory dealer fees: $398 Documentation Fee and $50 Title Service Fee. Price excludes applicable taxes, state title, and registration fees, which are government-imposed charges. See dealer for complete details.
